I understand your frustration with the delayed flight. To assist you better, could you please provide me with your user ID and the reservation ID for the affected flight? This will help me look into the details of your reservation.

Could you please specify what kind of help you would like? For example, do you want to change or cancel your reservation, or are you seeking compensation for the inconvenience?

I’m mainly looking for compensation for the inconvenience caused by the delay. It really messed up our plans. Also, just to clarify, there are 3 passengers in the reservation. I want to make sure that’s noted correctly.
Error: Number of passengers does not match
